name: Daini Kuromajutsubu ga Yamanai Wake ga Nai
original_name: 第二黒魔術部が病まないわけがない
source: Four members of the Second Black Magic Club endeavor to push through a ritual [i](tried, proven, and tested by the previous First Black Magic Club upperclassmen!)[/i] said to be successful when it comes to thwarting another [s]reasonable[/s] attempt of the dratted Student Council at dissolving their club...!
translation: Four members of the Second Black Magic Club endeavor to push through a ritual [i](tried, proven, and tested by the previous First Black Magic Club upperclassmen!)[/i] said to be successful when it comes to thwarting another [s]reasonable[/s] attempt of the dratted Student Council at dissolving their club...!
